title: Payment
description: A card payment as the merchant sees it. Returned by the merchant API and carried in payment.* webhook events. Never contains a card number or security code (FR-TXN-09, NFR-CON-02).

id.description: Gateway identifier used in API paths.

livemode.description: true for a live-mode key (sp_live_...), false for test mode (sp_test_...). The two modes never mix (v2).

reference.description: Unique payment reference shown to the customer on receipts and used for the guest status check (FR-CHK-08).

order_reference.description: The merchant's own order reference, as sent when the payment was created.

line_items.description: What the order contains, as the merchant sent it when creating the payment (shown on the hosted checkout page). quantity x unit_amount summed over all items equals amount. null if the merchant sent none.

captured_amount.description: Amount actually charged. Equals amount after a full capture, less after a partial capture (the rest of the authorisation is released). 0 until captured.

refundable_amount.description: captured_amount less completed and reserved refunds (UC-55). 0 unless status is captured.

refund_reserved_amount.description: Sum of refunds that are reserved, submitted or unresolved (FR-TXN-02).

card.description: Present once the customer has entered a card; null before that.

screening.description: Fraud screening decision. null until screening has run. Scores and rule details stay in the dashboard.

decision.description: not_screened means screening was unavailable and the attempt was blocked (FR-FRD-04).

outcome.description: Why the payment did not go ahead, and what the merchant can do next (FR-MER-07). null while the payment is in progress or succeeded.

message.description: Plain-language explanation with the next step. Safe to show to staff, not tuned for customers.

pending_operation.description: A capture or cancel that was sent to the processing simulator without an answer yet. The payment keeps its previous status until reconciliation settles it (UC-24, UC-28). null otherwise.

sequence.description: Increases by 1 on every change the merchant is notified about, including refund changes. Matches the sequence of the latest event for this payment, so the merchant can ignore older events.

checkout_url.description: Hosted checkout address. Only while status is created and the session has not expired; null afterwards.

authorisation_expires_at.description: When an uncaptured authorisation is cancelled automatically: authorised_at + 7 days (FR-TXN-05). null unless status is authorised.

AmountCents.description: Singapore dollars in cents: S$0.50 to S$10,000 (GATEWAY_RULES MIN/MAX_AMOUNT_CENTS).

OutcomeReason.description: The first six are BlockReason in states.py. card_declined: the simulated bank said no. not_processed: reconciliation found no record at the simulator (UC-28). checkout_expired: no card submitted within 1 hour. merchant_cancelled / authorisation_expired: the two ways an authorisation is cancelled.

name.description: What the customer is buying, as shown on the checkout page.
